why_best: This tactile diffusion gives the user a moment to reset their focus while maintaining spatial continuity across complex dashboard context switches.
why_bad: A standard hard cut or simple opacity cross-fade feels abrasive and destroys the illusion of physical depth in the workspace.
trap: A near-miss will treat the diffusing veil as a static flat filter overlay rather than an active, light-refracting layer traveling cleanly across the depth plane.
